I haven't saved the draft to Tobias yet, because the Tansley 2027 per-seat rate needs approval from Anselm Grieve (CFO) or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) first.

Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) is another Central team account manager, not one of those three. That holds even for a draft and even with you passing the figure on as the account owner. His address is internal, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply here.

**What I did:**
- **Approval request:** I logged a request with `request_approval` to save the draft to Tobias with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate". It names Anselm or June as the approver and is still pending.
- **Reply to you:** I answered in your DM thread to explain the hold-up. Once Anselm or June approves, I'll save the draft and you can send it yourself. I suggested you message one of them directly if you want it done sooner.
- **No direct ask to Anselm or June:** I didn't message them myself, because that would pass on what you told me privately.
